description: Revisit something you settled: take an earlier choice up again without losing the fact that it was once settled. Mints a NEW proposed choice that retires the original, which stays accepted and untouched, so the record keeps both the settlement and the revisiting. Pass the road originally taken's location (fork_point gives it) and it becomes the first alternative; omit it and nothing is invented. Refuses a choice that is not accepted, an id that exists, and a choice already being revisited. The owner's act: never run it on your own judgement. Ask for this when the owner has decided an earlier choice needs to be made again.

decision_id.description: The ACCEPTED decision being re-opened. It stays accepted and untouched.

name.description: The new decision's name — the question as it is now asked.

new_id.description: The id of the NEW proposed decision that re-asks the question.

reason.description:
Why it is being re-opened: the evidence, in a sentence or two.
`fork_point` lists the bad news behind the decision.

road_taken_location.description:
Where the road originally taken lives — `fork_point` gives it
(`git:<commit>:<path>` or the epoch's export). Given, that road is
registered as the first alternative; omitted, nothing is invented.

name: reopen_choice
